# Support

Need help with Azan Prayer Times? Here are the best ways to get support.

## Documentation

First, check the documentation:
- **[Getting Started](../docs/QUICKSTART.md)** - 5-minute setup guide
- **[Setup Guide](../docs/SETUP.md)** - Detailed development environment setup
- **[API Reference](../docs/API.md)** - External API documentation
- **[Troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)** - Common issues and solutions
- **[FAQ](../docs/FAQ.md)** - Frequently asked questions

## GitHub Issues

For bugs and feature requests:
1. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Azan-Prayer-F/issues)
2. If not found, create a new issue with:
   - Clear title and description
   - Steps to reproduce (for bugs)
   - Expected vs actual behavior
   - Browser/OS/Node version information

## Security Issues

**Do not** report security vulnerabilities in public issues. See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure.

## Questions & Discussions

For general questions and discussions:
- Check [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Mostafa-SAID7/Azan-Prayer-F/discussions)
- Search for similar questions first
- Provide context: browser, OS, Node version, what you tried

## Email Support

For urgent matters:
- **Email**: dev.mohamedsakr@gmail.com
- Response time: Usually within 48 hours

## Community

- **Star the repo** if you find it useful
- **Share your feedback** in Discussions
- **Contribute** improvements - see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Deployment Issues

If you're having issues deploying to Vercel:
1. Check [DEPLOYMENT.md](../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)
2. Verify environment variables are set
3. Check Vercel dashboard for build logs
4. See [CI_CD.md](../docs/CI_CD.md) for workflow details

## Performance Issues

If the app is slow:
1. Check browser DevTools Network tab
2. Clear browser cache
3. Check Lighthouse score: `npm run lighthouse`
4. Review [Performance](../docs/CI_CD.md#performance) section

## Browser Compatibility

Supported browsers:
- Chrome/Edge 90+
- Firefox 88+
- Safari 14+
- Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)

## Before Asking

- Have you searched existing issues?
- Have you read the relevant documentation?
- Can you reproduce the issue consistently?
- Have you tried the latest version?

Providing good context helps us help you faster!
